title: LLINBO: Trustworthy LLM-in-the-Loop Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2505.14756v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a sequential decision-making tool widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable adaptability in low-data regimes, making them promising tools for black-box optimization by leveraging contextual knowledge to propose high-quality query points. However, LLMs lack explicit surrogate modeling and calibrated uncertainty, and their internal mechanisms remain opaque. This structural opacity can result in unnecessary experiments, which are costly in BO and may prevent the search from approaching the optimum. To address this, we propose LLINBO: LLM-in-the-Loop BO, a general framework that wraps existing LLM-based BO approaches, deciding when and how to act on their suggestions and when to revert to classical BO. translated_title: LLINBO：可信的环内大语言模型贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）是一种广泛用于优化昂贵黑盒函数的序贯决策工具。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）在低数据场景中展现出卓越的适应性，通过利用上下文知识提出高质量的查询点，使其成为黑盒优化领域颇具前景的工具。然而，大语言模型缺乏显式的代理建模和经过校准的不确定性估计，其内部机制也仍然不透明。这种结构性不透明可能导致不必要的实验，而这些实验在贝叶斯优化中成本高昂，并可能阻碍搜索过程逼近最优解。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LLINBO：环内大语言模型贝叶斯优化，这是一个通用框架，它封装了现有的基于大语言模型的贝叶斯优化方法，决定何时以及如何采纳其建议，何时回退到经典贝叶斯优化。我们为此交互引入了三种机制，每种机制都配有无害理论保证，确保次线性累积（遗憾）。
tldr: 本文提出LLINBO框架，通过智能决定何时采纳大语言模型的优化建议、何时回退到经典贝叶斯优化，并配有无害理论保证，解决了大语言模型内部机制不透明导致昂贵低效实验的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LLINBO, a general framework that wraps existing LLM-based Bayesian optimization approaches by deciding when to act on LLM suggestions and when to revert to classical BO, with no-harm theoretical guarantees addressing the costly inefficiency caused by LLMs' opaque internal mechanisms.
